provider_receipt.summary: Joined completion is unsupported. The only declared check proves a clean tree, while the supplied functional test evidence records `cargo test --all-targets` exiting 101. Security/privacy defects also contradict the ingestion objective: `src/lib.rs:184-192` permits absolute and `../` wikilinks to resolve outside the private vault, and `src/lib.rs:173-175` exposes any existing external target as a backlink. The implementation does not enforce the documented ingestion contract: `src/lib.rs:13-25` omits authority, privacy, review, provenance, and conflict fields and uses an incompatible numeric confidence type; `src/lib.rs:106-129` ingests every Markdown file without classification; and `src/lib.rs:56-89` serializes then discards memory records rather than persisting them. The second joined close receipt contains only a generic closure assertion and no implementation or verification evidence available within this review scope.
